name: What materials are best for a durable and water-resistant bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What materials are best for a durable and water-resistant bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: For durability and water resistance, focus on materials designed for high-moisture environments. Porcelain or ceramic tile is excellent for flooring and shower walls due to its non-porous nature and longevity. Solid surface materials like quartz or granite are ideal for countertops. For cabinetry, consider moisture-resistant options like marine-grade plywood or solid wood with proper sealing. Ensure high-quality waterproofing membranes are installed behind shower tiles and around wet areas to prevent leaks and mold.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize porcelain or ceramic tile for flooring/walls, solid surface for countertops, and moisture-resistant cabinetry with proper waterproofing for durability.
